# awscc_ssm_default_host_management_configuration (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::SSM::DefaultHostManagementConfiguration. Enables or disables Default Host Management Configuration (DHMC) for an AWS account and Region by managing the '/ssm/managed-instance/default-ec2-instance-management-role' service setting. This is a singleton resource - there is at most one DHMC configuration per account/Region.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permission_model` (String) The permission model used to enable DHMC. SERVICE_MANAGED lets SSM create and manage the DHMC IAM role on your behalf. SELF_MANAGED registers an IAM role that you provide.

### Optional

- `customer_managed_role_arn` (String) The ARN of the customer-provided IAM role to register for DHMC. Required when PermissionModel is SELF_MANAGED and must not be set when PermissionModel is SERVICE_MANAGED.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_modified_date` (String) The date the DHMC service setting was last modified.
- `last_modified_user` (String) The principal that last modified the DHMC service setting.
- `role_arn` (String) The ARN of the IAM role currently configured for DHMC. For SERVICE_MANAGED this is the SSM-created role in the IAM reserved path; for SELF_MANAGED this echoes the registered CustomerManagedRoleArn.
- `setting_arn` (String) The ARN of the DHMC service setting.
- `setting_id` (String) The ID of the DHMC service setting. This is a fixed value that uniquely identifies the DHMC configuration for the account and Region.
- `status` (String) The status of the DHMC service setting. 'Default' indicates DHMC is not configured; 'Customized' indicates a role is configured.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ssm_default_host_management_configuration.example
  identity = {
    setting_id = "setting_id"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `setting_id` (String) The ID of the DHMC service setting

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_ssm_default_host_management_configuration.example
  id = "setting_id"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
$ terraform import awscc_ssm_default_host_management_configuration.example "setting_id"
```
